comment: AC: Gary's Deli, Arena Branch. Prices in Deli Tickets (earned per wave; story-mode Rift runs pay money instead). Snacks go in the backpack (combat Quick); a meal buffs the party until the next camp (one at a time; mutator-style effects); the special is a card pack (choose 1 of 3, then the owner). stockSize items per camp; minWave gates better stock.

items.name: The Hero Sub
items.text: Until the next camp: +10% max HP for everyone.

items.name: Runner's Wrap
items.text: Until the next camp: +1 Movement for everyone.

items.name: Brain Food Platter
items.text: Until the next camp: +1 MP regen for everyone.

items.name: Mystery Card Pack
items.text: Choose 1 of 3 cards, then who gets it.
